$comment: quantum-lens config. This is the single file that makes the framework generalize. Edit `stack` and the `gates` commands to match your project. Any gate set to null is skipped. The visual.* gates only make sense for projects that render a UI; set them to null for APIs/CLIs/libraries and the visual layer disappears automatically.

gates._comment: Each value is a shell command run from the project root, or null to skip. Exit code 0 = pass. These become the verification commands quantum-loop's Iron Law demands as evidence.

visual._comment: Settings for the visual gate. breakpoints drive responsive screenshots; lighthouse thresholds gate quality scores.
